cover.coreProposition: Cross-agent history should be a destination-specific, policy-enforcing projection of mixed-trust local state: remove unauthorized control material while its semantic structure is still available, preserve legitimate local evidence separately, and do not mistake selective projection for general confidentiality or peer trust.
cover.visualMetaphor: A glass archive prism retaining a full spectrum locally while releasing only an authorized narrow beam across a boundary
cover.semanticObject: One archival prism with a rich incoming spectrum and a clean destination-specific outgoing beam
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with one central optical object, restrained indigo and cyan light, clear boundary depth and strong thumbnail silhouette
